question: Should the durable spawned-session chain identifier be a dedicated session-chain ID, reuse diagnostic tracing, or remain unsupported beyond current parent/depth lineage?
rationale: Current code establishes direct lineage and registry traversal but does not define whether observability trace context is durable session identity; that persisted public contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Dedicated chain ID
options.body: Add an optional immutable identifier scoped to a spawned session chain and keep it separate from diagnostic tracing.

options.title: Reuse diagnostic trace
options.body: Persist or bridge the observability trace identifier, accepting tighter coupling between diagnostics and session state.

options.title: Keep direct lineage
options.body: Retain parent/depth plus registry traversal and decline a new root/trace session contract.

recommendation.title: Dedicated chain ID
recommendation.body: Add an optional immutable identifier scoped to a spawned session chain and keep it separate from diagnostic tracing.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has already reviewed the exact product/API question publicly and has adjacent recent subagent-registry history.
